{{Quote|This is war, Captain Brandei. Not an opportunity for personal revenge.''"<br />"''I understand my duty, Admiral.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Brandei]]|<ref name="Last Command" />}}
The '''Battle of Filve''' took place during [[Thrawn campaign]] and was a diversion to distract the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] away from the [[Battle at Ukio]].

==Prelude==
[[File:Ord_Pardron_feints.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Map showing [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] assaults against [[Filve]] and other planets in the region during his campaign to take [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]].]]

The assault on [[Filve]] was used as a feint to draw New Republic forces away from [[Ord Pardron/Legends|Ord Pardron]], which in turn left the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] vulnerable. [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] forces attacked the planet but the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] were present in the system. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] was on a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] mission to Filve in order to reassure the [[Filvian]]s, but the ''Millennium Falcon'' didn't manage to reach the planet.

==The Battle==
The ''Millennium Falcon'' and Rogue Squadron tried to flee, but [[Joruus C'baoth]], coordinating the [[Battle at Ukio]], sensed Leia Organa Solo's presence and sent [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Brandei]]'s entire fleet to capture her. The Rogues and the ''Falcon'' were eventually able to escape safely through the use of the [[Cracken Twist]].

==Aftermath==
Once again, C'baoth's intervention disturbed the Grand Admiral's battle plan and left much more time for the Filvians to organize their defense, making Thrawn and [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] furious against the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].
